C06: Each control volume satisfies discrete conservation with source and decay.
Zero drift, reverse drift and large cell Péclet numbers remain stable.
Nonuniform control-volume widths and both Dirichlet boundaries are preserved.
C07: Eliminate each experiment’s independent amplitude and baseline using the known heteroscedastic uncertainty.
Construct absolute χ² profile intervals for nonlinear diffusivity and flag boundary truncation.
Distinguish a finite least-squares point estimate from unidentifiable parameters.
C08: Use nonuniform control volumes and direction-dependent harmonic face coefficients.
Output outward integrated fluxes at all four boundaries using the same discretization as the linear system.
Provide independent manufactured-solution, global-conservation and grid-refinement checks.
C09: Solve the specified discrete Poisson and SG continuity equations together, rather than freezing potential.
Maintain positive density and damped nonlinear convergence; do not clip output to conceal residuals.
Verify equilibrium zero current, current-carrying manufactured solutions, gauge shifts and grids.
C10: The implicit two-species conversion strictly conserves mass; tangent derivatives describe the discrete update.
Use known absolute sigma for weighted two-parameter inversion, rank diagnosis and correct covariance.
JSON restart preserves complete physical and parameter-tangent states.
Parametric bootstrap uses the specified independent pseudorandom stream and genuinely refits each replicate.
